analyst.summary: Aster DM Healthcare is now a pure India hospital operator after selling its Gulf business in 2024, and the underlying India operations are growing well -- patient volumes, revenue, and margins are all improving, with high-value specialties like cardiac and oncology growing fastest. However, some of the standard valuation and return figures for this stock (a very high trailing P/E and an unusually high return-on-equity) are likely distorted by the 2024 business separation and do not reflect a stable, comparable picture, and a further large merger (with Quality Care India, backed by Blackstone) is expected to close soon and will change the numbers again. We rate this a Hold: solid underlying hospital business, but the reported valuation metrics need to be read with real caution right now.
